475: function Trc = relay_currents_table_v2(Mtrx, TiJ)
476: %RELAY_CURRENTS_TABLE_V2  One row per finite matrix side + I0 context.
477: %   I_primary = I_secondary x CT_device (matrix sides are secondary amperes;
478: %   CTs are v2 15000/1600 via the graded matrix). Secondary arithmetic is
479: %   frozen phase5_ct (the single source of truth; the phase5_ct_table
480: %   wrapper rejects 1600 by locked guard and frozen files stay untouched).
481: %   I0_A joins real production Iseq0; LG-exact If/3 only when the join
482: %   truly lacks I0; LLG-without-Iseq0 -> NaN, never invented.
483: ml = tocell(Mtrx.fault_location); mt = tocell(Mtrx.fault_type); mc = tocell(Mtrx.caseID);
484: jl = tocell(TiJ.fault_location); jt = tocell(TiJ.fault_type); jc = tocell(TiJ.caseID);
485: Jseq = double(TiJ.Iseq0_kA(:)); Jtot = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
486: oLoc = {}; oTyp = {}; oCase = {}; oDev = {}; oSide = {};
487: oIp = []; oIk = []; oCt = []; oIs = []; oI0 = []; oSrc = {};
488: oProv = {}; oScope = {};
489: PROV = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-branch-through-current-via-frozen-phase5_coord;' ...
490:     'secondaries-via-frozen-phase5_ct-arithmetic-v2-CTs-15000-gen-1600-GSUT-GIS'];
491: for i = 1:height(Mtrx)
492:     j = find(strcmp(jc, mc{i}) & strcmp(jl, ml{i}) & strcmp(jt, mt{i}), 1, 'first');
493:     if isempty(j)
494:         error('phase5b_production:join', ...
495:             'relay-currents join missed %s %s %s.', mc{i}, ml{i}, mt{i});
496:     end
497:     if isfinite(Jseq(j))
498:         i0 = Jseq(j) * 1000;
499:         src = 'Iseq0-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-production';
500:     elseif strcmp(mt{i}, 'LG')
501:         i0 = Jtot(j) / 3;
502:         src = 'LG-exact-If/3-DERIVED';
503:     else
504:         i0 = NaN;
505:         src = 'MISSING-no-Iseq0-LLG-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
506:     end
507:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_down_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_down(i))
508:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
509:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.downstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'downstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
510:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
511:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
512:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
513:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
514:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
515:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
516:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
517:     end
518:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_up_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_up(i))
519:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
520:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.upstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'upstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
521:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
522:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
523:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
524:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
525:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
526:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
527:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
528:     end
529: end
530: Trc = table(oLoc', oTyp', oCase', oDev', oSide', oIp', oIk', oCt', ...
531:     oIs', oI0', oSrc', oProv', oScope', ...
532:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', ...
533:     'device_id', 'side', 'I_primary_A', 'I_primary_kA', 'CT_ratio', ...
534:     'I_secondary_A', 'I0_A', 'I0_source', 'provenance', 'scope'});
535: if height(Trc) < 1
536:     error('phase5b_production:rows', 'relay-currents table empty (matrix sides all missing).');
537: end
538: end

581: function S = sensitivity_v2(T40, devicesProd, Rreg)
582: %SENSITIVITY_V2  v2-adapted GEN-scope sensitivity (C11 BLOCKED fallback).
583: %   The frozen PHASE5_SENSITIVITY is BLOCKED for v2 reuse (never modified):
584: %   it hard-codes the v1 2000 CT on its upstream GSUT leg
585: %   (phase5_sensitivity.m:137 'IsUp = pkUp / 2000', :190 'primUp / 2000',
586: %   :193 reason 'upstream-GSUT-HV-51-2000/1-untouched', comments :9/:11)
587: %   instead of reading device ct_ratio (1600 in v2). Evidence pinned in
588: %   test_phase5b_writer. This engine ports the frozen GEN-scope doctrine
589: %   exactly, reading every pickup/CT/TMS from the v2-resolved devices:
590: %     GEN-51 (phase, all 40 combos) + GEN-51N (earth, LG/LLG only, 20 rows)
591: %     = 60 rows; GEN dial fixed from the PRIMARY scheme via the device CT
592: %     (Is_fixed = P/ct_device, 15000); legacy secondaries via Rreg.ct_legacy
593: %     (16000 fence, read never hard-coded); upstream GSUT-HV-51 backup via
594: %     ITS device CT (1600 — the fix) with the v2-resolved pickup/TMS;
595: %     EF TMS 0.15 from the stamped devices (pickup-resolved, never registry
596: %     0.20). Frozen phase5_ct + phase5_time + phase5_ct_table(T40,16000)
597: %     audit reference only (legacy fence unchanged in v2).
598: %   Relay primaries mirror frozen branch parity: GEN-51 phase -> GEN_Q leg
599: %   else net total; GEN-51N F1/F2 -> 3xI0 neutral-once else LG-exact If/3
600: %   else NaN; GEN-51N F3/F4/F5 -> 3x leg_NER_earth delta block else NaN.
601: %   Verdict doctrine identical to frozen (CTI 0.3 s; NO-TRIP / NO-PAIR /
602: %   NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA). 28 locked cols, scope
603: %   SENSITIVITY, provenance LEGACY-tagged + v2-adaptation note.
604: d51 = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51');
605: d51N = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51N');
606: dUp = finddev(devicesProd, 'GSUT-HV-51');
607: ctGen = read_ct(d51, 'GEN-51');
608: ctLeg = double(Rreg.ct_legacy);
609: if ~(isscalar(ctLeg) && isfinite(ctLeg) && ctLeg > 0)
610:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'Rreg.ct_legacy must be finite > 0 (16000 fence, read never hard-coded).');
611: end
612: ctUp = read_ct(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
613: pk51 = read_pickup(d51, 'GEN-51');
614: pkN = read_pickup(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
615: pkUp = read_pickup(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
616: [tms51, cv51] = read_tc(d51, 'GEN-51');
617: [tmsN, cvN] = read_tc(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
618: [tmsUp, cvUp] = read_tc(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
619: IsFix51 = pk51 / ctGen;
620: IsFixN = pkN / ctGen;
621: IsUp = pkUp / ctUp;
622: CTI = 0.3;
623: locs = tocell(T40.fault_location);
624: typs = tocell(T40.fault_type);
625: cases = tocell(T40.caseID);
626: n = height(T40);
627: If_A = double(T40.I_primary_A(:));
628: If_kA = double(T40.I_primary_kA(:));
629: if any(~isfinite(If_A)) || any(~isfinite(If_kA))
630:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'T40 fault currents must be finite.');
631: end
632: hasIseq0 = any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, 'Iseq0_kA'));
633: if hasIseq0
634:     Iseq0_kA = double(T40.Iseq0_kA(:));
635: else
636:     Iseq0_kA = NaN(n, 1);
637: end

function [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests(varargin)
%RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS  Phase-5b test runner (Phase-5b Task C12).
%   [NP, NF] = RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS() runs every matlab/tests/test_phase5b_*.m
%   suite (discovered via the test_phase5b_ledger anchor on the path, so gap
%   suites are picked up without runner edits) plus the 14-leg
%   phase5b_validate() engine (R0 Phase-4 regression + B01..B13), accumulates
%   passed/failed counts (each validation leg counts one check), and prints
%   'phase5b_tests: NP passed, NF failed'.
%   A suite that errors counts one failure and the runner continues, so one
%   broken suite never hides the rest; the error text stays loud.
%   The frozen v1 runner is never called or modified (see plan global
%   constraints).
%   All errors raised here are 'phase5b'-prefixed.
if nargin ~= 0
    error('phase5b_tests:args', 'usage: [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests().');
end
anchor = which('test_phase5b_ledger');
if isempty(anchor)
    error('phase5b_tests:path', 'test_phase5b_ledger not on path (run with addpath(genpath(''matlab''))).');
end

1: function R = run_phase5_production(tag, varargin)
2: %RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION  End-to-end Phase-5 production driver (Task 17/T20).
3: %   R = RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION(tag) builds every Phase-5 protection output
4: %   from the frozen Phase-4 production archive (read-only) and writes
5: %   results/phase5_protection/ via PHASE5_WRITER:
6: %     9 CSVs (device_registry, relay_settings, fault_inputs,
7: %     relay_currents, coordination_matrix, coordination_margins,
8: %     breaker_duty, sensitivity, validation) + manifest.json + run_log.txt
9: %     + sha256.txt, plus TCC plots via PHASE5_TCC into plots/.
10: %
11: %   R = RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION(tag, 'overwrite', true) re-runs into the
12: %   existing results/phase5_protection directory. Without the flag, an
13: %   existing directory errors error('phase5_production:exists').
14: %   Default tag 'production' (manifest tag only; the output directory is
15: %   fixed results/phase5_protection).
16: %
17: %   Binding carry-forwards (locked, read ALL consumers first):
18: %   (a) Relay settings/pickups use the T6 PRODUCTION path: GIS-Q0-51 =
19: %       1.2 x FL_anchor read live from phase4_ct_data.csv FL_anchor_kA
20: %       (LINE_Q9 path; ~1043.95 A), never the 2400 A rated-proxy fallback
21: %       that phase5_coord/phase5_tcc use internally when the registry
22: %       carries NaN pickup. Production pickups are stamped into a devices
23: %       copy (registry never edited) so phase5_coord grades production
24: %       settings (T6-registry source). TCC footers keep their disclosed
25: %       fallback; production CSVs carry production values.
26: %   (b) Iseq0_kA is joined live from phase4_fault_currents.csv
27: %       (backbone-first dedup identical to phase5_import) into the import
28: %       table before phase5_coord, and into relay-currents/earth rows, so
29: %       LLG earth uses real I0; the I0-NOT-DETERMINABLE path only fires
30: %       where production truly lacks I0.
31: %   (c) r_kappa_ip (borrowed-shape peak, informational only) is joined the
32: %       same way and passes through phase5_duty into I_peak_kA; missing ->
33: %       NaN + MISSING-peak note, never invented.
34: %   (d) Task-15 full close: phase5_writer errors on any empty
35: %       provenance/scope (phase5_writer:provenance).
36: %   (e) TCC plots regenerate via phase5_tcc into
37: %       results/phase5_protection/plots/ as part of this run
38: %       (deterministic overwrite within the new dir only).
39: %   (f) manifest.json carries tag, timestamp, the INPUT production
40: %       manifest SHA-256 (production manifest.json hashed read-only plus
41: %       the production sha256.txt lines transcribed), code SHA-256 of
42: %       every matlab/phase5/*.m, row counts, and the live phase5_validate
43: %       reference. sha256.txt covers the 9 CSVs + manifest + run_log +
44: %       validation CSV (11 lines). run_log.txt carries settings + row
45: %       counts + validation/test counts. Existing modules are consumed
46: %       with their exact call signatures and never modified.
47: %
48: %   Validation/tests: live phase5_validate() supplies the validation CSV
49: %   and manifest reference; run_phase5_tests() runs after the tables and
50: %   TCC plots but BEFORE phase5_writer, so NP/NF land in run_log.txt
51: %   before sha256.txt is hashed (never appended after hashing). Counts
52: %   are recorded honestly, never gated-to-pass here (the T19 gate judges).
53: %   All errors are 'phase5'-prefixed.
54: t0run = tic;
55: if nargin < 1 || isempty(tag)
56:     tag = 'production';
57: end
58: if isstring(tag) && isscalar(tag), tag = char(tag); end
59: if ~(ischar(tag) && isrow(tag) && ~isempty(tag))
60:     error('phase5_production:badTag', 'tag must be a non-empty char rowvec (manifest tag).');
61: end
62: overwrite = false;
63: for k = 1:2:numel(varargin)
64:     nm = varargin{k};
65:     if isstring(nm), nm = char(nm); end
66:     if k + 1 > numel(varargin)
67:         error('phase5_production:args', 'Name-value options need a value.');
68:     end
69:     vv = varargin{k + 1};
70:     switch lower(nm)
71:         case 'overwrite'
72:             overwrite = logical(vv);
73:         otherwise
74:             error('phase5_production:args', 'Unknown option ''%s''.', nm);
75:     end
76: end
77: root = ashuganj_root();
78: outDir = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase5_protection');
79: if exist(outDir, 'dir') == 7 && ~overwrite
80:     error('phase5_production:exists', ...
81:         'Output directory %s exists; re-run with ''overwrite'', true.', outDir);
82: end
83: % ---- (f) INPUT production manifest SHA, read-only ----
84: prodMan = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'manifest.json');
85: prodSha = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'sha256.txt');
86: if exist(prodMan, 'file') ~= 2
87:     error('phase5_production:input', 'production manifest missing (read-only input): %s', prodMan);
88: end
89: if exist(prodSha, 'file') ~= 2
90:     error('phase5_production:input', 'production sha256.txt missing (read-only input): %s', prodSha);
91: end
92: inputManifestSha = sha256file(prodMan);
93: inputShaLines = strsplit(strtrim(fileread(prodSha)), '\n');
94: inputShaLines = inputShaLines(:)';
95: % ---- Registry + backbone import (40 rows, 2x5x4 Ikpp) ----
96: Rreg = phase5_registry();
97: Ti = phase5_import(root);
98: if height(Ti) ~= 40
99:     error('phase5_production:matrix', 'phase5_import backbone row count %d ~= 40.', height(Ti));
100: end
101: % ---- (b)+(c) Iseq0_kA + r_kappa_ip joins from production currents ----
102: TiJ = join_production_peaks(root, Ti);
103: % ---- (a) FL anchors live from production ct_data (frozen flows) ----
104: anchors = read_anchors(root);
105: % Imin anchors, coord-consistent (totals-based; branch legs affect times only).
106: [IminPhase, IminEarth] = pickup_anchors(TiJ);
107: % ---- (a) T6 PRODUCTION pickups, stamped into a devices copy ----
108: [devicesProd, setRows, settingsLines] = production_settings(Rreg, anchors, IminPhase, IminEarth);
109: % ---- Tables 1-3: registry / settings / fault_inputs ----
110: Tregistry = registry_table(Rreg);
111: TfaultInputs = table(Ti.fault_location, Ti.fault_type, Ti.caseID, Ti.m, ...
112:     Ti.stage, Ti.I_primary_kA, Ti.I_primary_A, Ti.provenance, ...
113:     repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Ti), 1), ...
114:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'm', ...
115:     'stage', 'I_primary_kA', 'I_primary_A', 'provenance', 'scope'});
116: % ---- Coordination on production settings + joined Iseq0 ----
117: [Mtrx, Mrg] = phase5_coord(devicesProd, TiJ);
118: Mtrx.provenance = repmat({['DERIVED:phase5_coord-branch-through-current-' ...
119:     'margin-CTI-0.3s-study-threshold-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-import']}, height(Mtrx), 1);
120: Mtrx.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Mtrx), 1);
121: Mrg.provenance = repmat({['DERIVED:phase5_coord-margin-dt-t_up-minus-t_down-' ...
122:     'SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-import']}, height(Mrg), 1);
123: Mrg.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Mrg), 1);
124: % ---- Relay currents traced from the graded matrix sides ----
125: TrelayCurrents = relay_currents_table(Mtrx, TiJ);
126: % ---- Breaker duty on breaker-path through-currents + peak passthrough ----
127: Dduty = phase5_duty(TiJ, []);
128: Dprov = repmat({'SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-through-current-branch'}, height(Dduty), 1);
129: isNote = strcmp(tocell(Dduty.verdict), 'NOTE');
130: Dprov(isNote) = {'ESTIMATED:50.00-kA-station-reference-informational-only-never-duty-basis'};
131: Dduty.provenance = Dprov;
132: Dduty.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Dduty), 1);
133: % ---- Fenced sensitivity (production-stamped devices; GEN outputs identical) ----
134: Tsens = phase5_sensitivity(TiJ, devicesProd);
135: % ---- Live validation -> validation CSV + manifest reference ----
136: V = phase5_validate();
137: vPass = sum([V.legs.pass]); vTotal = numel(V.legs);
138: vIds = strjoin({V.legs.id}, ',');
139: vNote = sprintf('live phase5_validate %d/%d legs pass (%s)', vPass, vTotal, vIds);
140: Tvalid = table({V.legs.id}', double([V.legs.pass]'), [V.legs.residual]', ...
141:     {V.legs.note}', ...
142:     repmat({'DERIVED:phase5_validate-live-run-R0-V1-V15'}, vTotal, 1), ...
143:     repmat({'PRIMARY'}, vTotal, 1), ...
144:     'VariableNames', {'leg', 'pass', 'residual', 'note', 'provenance', 'scope'});
145: % ---- (e) TCC plots regenerate into the new plots dir ----
146: plotDir = fullfile(outDir, 'plots');
147: Stcc = phase5_tcc(plotDir, root);
148: settingsLines{end + 1} = sprintf('TCC plots regenerated via phase5_tcc: %s, %s', ... %#ok<AGROW>
149:     Stcc.gen_png, Stcc.grid_png);
150: % ---- Tests run BEFORE the writer so counts land in run_log pre-hash ----
151: [NP, NF] = run_phase5_tests();
152: % ---- Writer (d: provenance full close enforced inside) ----
153: tables = struct('registry', Tregistry, 'settings', setRows, ...
154:     'faultInputs', TfaultInputs, 'relayCurrents', TrelayCurrents, ...
155:     'coordMatrix', Mtrx, 'coordMargins', Mrg, 'duty', Dduty, ...
156:     'sensitivity', Tsens, 'validation', Tvalid);
157: meta = struct('tag', tag, 'inputManifestSha', inputManifestSha, ...
158:     'inputShaLines', {inputShaLines}, ...
159:     'validation', struct('pass', vPass, 'total', vTotal, 'note', vNote), ...
160:     'testCounts', struct('NP', NP, 'NF', NF), ...
161:     'settingsLines', {settingsLines}, ...
162:     'extraNotes', {{'TCC plots (tcc_gen.png, tcc_grid.png) in plots/ are study-curve figures, not hashed in sha256.txt.'}});
163: W = phase5_writer(outDir, tables, meta);
164: secs = toc(t0run);
165: fprintf(['run_phase5_production %s: registry=%d settings=%d inputs=%d currents=%d ' ...
166:     'matrix=%d margins=%d duty=%d sens=%d valid=%d/%d tests NP=%d NF=%d in %s (%.1f s)\n'], ...
167:     tag, height(Tregistry), height(setRows), height(TfaultInputs), ...
168:     height(TrelayCurrents), height(Mtrx), height(Mrg), height(Dduty), ...
169:     height(Tsens), vPass, vTotal, NP, NF, outDir, secs);
170: R = struct('dir', outDir, 'tag', tag, 'rowCounts', W.rowCounts, ...
171:     'validatePass', vPass, 'validateTotal', vTotal, 'NP', NP, 'NF', NF, ...
172:     'genPng', Stcc.gen_png, 'gridPng', Stcc.grid_png, 'secs', secs);
173: end

175: function TiJ = join_production_peaks(root, Ti)
176: %JOIN_PRODUCTION_PEAKS  (b)+(c): Iseq0_kA + r_kappa_ip from currents CSV.
177: %   Backbone-first dedup identical to phase5_import (filter stage Ikpp +
178: %   m 0.5, first-per-(caseID,location,fault_type) in file order), then an
179: %   inner join on those keys. Every import row must hit, else
180: %   phase5_production:join (never silently NaN-filled).
181: Fp = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'phase4_fault_currents.csv');
182: C = readtable(Fp);
183: for k = 1:numel({'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'})
184:     need = {'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'};
185:     if ~any(strcmp(C.Properties.VariableNames, need{k}))
186:         error('phase5_production:schema', 'production currents CSV missing column %s.', need{k});
187:     end
188: end
189: Cb = C(strcmp(C.stage, 'Ikpp') & C.m == 0.5, :);
190: keys = strcat(Cb.caseID, '|', Cb.location, '|', Cb.fault_type);
191: [~, ia] = unique(keys, 'stable');
192: Cb = Cb(ia, :);
193: n = height(Ti);
194: Iseq0 = NaN(n, 1); rkp = NaN(n, 1);
195: tloc = tocell(Ti.fault_location); ttyp = tocell(Ti.fault_type); tcs = tocell(Ti.caseID);
196: bloc = tocell(Cb.location); btyp = tocell(Cb.fault_type); bcs = tocell(Cb.caseID);
197: for i = 1:n
198:     hit = find(strcmp(bcs, tcs{i}) & strcmp(bloc, tloc{i}) & strcmp(btyp, ttyp{i}), 1, 'first');
199:     if isempty(hit)
200:         error('phase5_production:join', ...
201:             'production currents join missed %s %s %s (backbone keys diverged).', ...
202:             tcs{i}, tloc{i}, ttyp{i});
203:     end
204:     Iseq0(i) = Cb.Iseq0_kA(hit);
205:     rkp(i) = Cb.r_kappa_ip(hit);
206: end
207: if any(~isfinite(Iseq0)) || any(~isfinite(rkp))
208:     error('phase5_production:join', 'joined Iseq0_kA/r_kappa_ip must be finite on all 40 backbone rows.');
209: end
210: TiJ = Ti;
211: TiJ.Iseq0_kA = Iseq0;
212: TiJ.r_kappa_ip = rkp;
213: end

215: function anchors = read_anchors(root)
216: %READ_ANCHORS  Frozen-flow FL_anchor_kA per through_path, live from ct_data.
217: G = readtable(fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'phase4_ct_data.csv'));
218: if ~all(ismember({'through_path', 'FL_anchor_kA'}, G.Properties.VariableNames))
219:     error('phase5_production:schema', 'production ct_data CSV missing through_path/FL_anchor_kA.');
220: end
221: paths = {'GEN_Q', 'GSUT_HV', 'GRID_Q', 'LINE_Q9'};
222: anchors = struct();
223: tp = tocell(G.through_path);
224: for k = 1:numel(paths)
225:     u = unique(G.FL_anchor_kA(strcmp(tp, paths{k})));
226:     u = u(isfinite(u));
227:     if numel(u) ~= 1
228:         error('phase5_production:anchor', ...
229:             'through_path %s must carry exactly one FL_anchor_kA (got %d).', paths{k}, numel(u));
230:     end
231:     anchors.(paths{k}) = u;
232: end
233: end

235: function [IminPhase, IminEarth] = pickup_anchors(TiJ)
236: %PICKUP_ANCHORS  Must-detect anchors for the T6 production pickup calls.
237: %   IminPhase: coord-consistent min over phase-fault totals (LLL/LL/LLG,
238: %   never LG earth). IminEarth: LG-only min over LG totals. The LG-only
239: %   restriction is the phase5_pickup contract ('EF uses F1 LG 7.27 A') and
240: %   matches validate V2/V9 legs plus the T6 methodology (GEN-51N 5 A
241: %   must-detect F1 LG with margin ~1.45). The LLG-inclusive 3I0 min that
242: %   phase5_coord uses INTERNALLY (LLG 3I0 ~3.63 A < 5 A pickup) stays
243: %   where it belongs: honest below-pickup NO-TRIP rows in the
244: %   coordination matrix, never in the settings must-detect anchor.
245: typs = tocell(TiJ.fault_type);
246: ph = strcmp(typs, 'LLL') | strcmp(typs, 'LL') | strcmp(typs, 'LLG');
247: IfA = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
248: if any(ph)
249:     IminPhase = min(IfA(ph));
250: else
251:     IminPhase = min(IfA);
252: end
253: lg = strcmp(typs, 'LG');
254: if any(lg)
255:     IminEarth = min(IfA(lg));
256: else
257:     IminEarth = 7.27200442799167;
258: end
259: end

261: function [devicesProd, setRows, settingsLines] = production_settings(Rreg, anchors, IminPhase, IminEarth)
262: %PRODUCTION_SETTINGS  (a): T6 PRODUCTION pickups stamped on a devices copy.
263: devs = Rreg.devices;
264: ids = {devs.device_id};
265: d51 = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51'));
266: d51N = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51N'));
267: dHV = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GSUT-HV-51'));
268: dQ0 = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GIS-Q0-51'));
269: % GEN-51: 1.25 x rated (12019 A -> 15023.75 A), no-trip-on-load vs rated.
270: P51 = phase5_pickup(d51, double(Rreg.gen.Irated_A), IminPhase);
271: if abs(P51.setting - 15023.75) > 1e-9
272:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GEN-51 production pickup %.4f A ~= 15023.75 A.', P51.setting);
273: end
274: % GEN-51N: 5 A SENSITIVE study setting, must-detect F1 LG.
275: PN = phase5_pickup(d51N, 0, IminEarth);
276: if abs(PN.setting - 5) > 1e-12
277:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GEN-51N production pickup %.6f A ~= 5 A.', PN.setting);
278: end
279: % GSUT-HV-51: generic 1.2 x max(rated, frozen-flow anchor).
280: hvAnchor = anchors.GSUT_HV * 1000;
281: PHV = phase5_pickup(dHV, hvAnchor, IminPhase);
282: % GIS-Q0-51 PRODUCTION PATH: 1.2 x LINE_Q9 FL_anchor (never rated-proxy).
283: q0Anchor = anchors.LINE_Q9 * 1000;
284: PQ0 = phase5_pickup(dQ0, q0Anchor, IminPhase);
285: if abs(PQ0.setting / q0Anchor - 1.2) > 1e-12
286:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GIS-Q0-51 production pickup must be 1.2x FL_anchor.');
287: end
288: if abs(PQ0.setting - 1.2 * 869.956651959241) > 1e-6
289:     error('phase5_production:pickup', ...
290:         'GIS-Q0-51 production pickup %.4f A drifts from 1.2x frozen LINE_Q9 anchor 1043.95 A.', PQ0.setting);
291: end
292: % Stamp into a copy (registry struct itself never edited).
293: devicesProd = devs;
294: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51')).pickup_A = P51.setting;
295: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51N')).pickup_A = PN.setting;
296: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GSUT-HV-51')).pickup_A = PHV.setting;
297: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GIS-Q0-51')).pickup_A = PQ0.setting;
298: % Applied TMS/curve mirror the coord study defaults (registry NaN/empty).
299: setRows = settings_table(devs, P51, PN, PHV, PQ0);
300: settingsLines = {
301:     sprintf('GEN-51 phase pickup %.2f A-primary (1.25x rated 12019 A; %s)', P51.setting, P51.basis)
302:     sprintf('GEN-51N earth pickup %.2f A-primary (SENSITIVE; %s)', PN.setting, PN.basis)
303:     sprintf('GSUT-HV-51 phase pickup %.2f A-primary (1.2x max(rated 1150 A, GSUT_HV anchor %.4f A); %s)', PHV.setting, hvAnchor, PHV.source)
304:     sprintf('GIS-Q0-51 phase pickup %.4f A-primary (PRODUCTION 1.2x LINE_Q9 FL_anchor %.6f A from phase4_ct_data.csv; never 2400 A rated-proxy)', PQ0.setting, q0Anchor)
305:     sprintf('FL anchors (phase4_ct_data.csv FL_anchor_kA, frozen flows): GEN_Q %.4f, GSUT_HV %.5f, GRID_Q %.5f, LINE_Q9 %.6f kA', anchors.GEN_Q, anchors.GSUT_HV, anchors.GRID_Q, anchors.LINE_Q9)
306:     sprintf('Imin anchors: phase %.2f A (LLL/LL/LLG totals min); earth %.5f A (LG totals min per T6 EF contract; LLG 3I0 below-pickup outcomes live honestly in the matrix)', IminPhase, IminEarth)
307:     'TMS study defaults (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION, registry NaN): GEN 0.1 / GSUT 0.2 / GIS 0.3; curve SI (STUDY constants, never manufacturer)'
308:     'CTI 0.3 s (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION study threshold); primary CT 15000/1 SOURCE-BACKED, 16000/1 LEGACY fenced sensitivity only'
309:     'Breaker duty: Q0 (52-1) only; Q1/Q2/Q9 disconnectors never duty; peak r_kappa_ip borrowed-shape informational only, never duty input'
310:     'CSV dialect: RFC-4180 comma-separated; text fields with commas are double-quoted (notably the GSUT-HV-51 basis cell). MATLAB readers must use readtable(fp,''Delimiter'','','') because the auto-delimiter sniffer misparses quoted-comma rows.'
311:     };
312: end

314: function setRows = settings_table(devs, P51, PN, PHV, PQ0)
315: %SETTINGS_TABLE  7-row relay_settings CSV (4 production + 3 MISSING).
316: ctOf = @(id) devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, id)).ct_ratio;
317: [t51, c51] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GEN-51')), 'GEN-51', 0.1);
318: [tN, cN] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GEN-51N')), 'GEN-51N', 0.1);
319: [tHV, cHV] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GSUT-HV-51')), 'GSUT-HV-51', 0.2);
320: [tQ0, cQ0] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GIS-Q0-51')), 'GIS-Q0-51', 0.3);
321: dids = {'GEN-51'; 'GEN-51N'; 'GSUT-HV-51'; 'GIS-Q0-51'; ...
322:     'GIS-Q0-50'; 'LINE-21-note'; 'REMOTE-GRID-boundary'};
323: sets = [P51.setting; PN.setting; PHV.setting; PQ0.setting; NaN; NaN; NaN];
324: units = {'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; ''; ''; ''};
325: basis = {P51.basis; PN.basis; PHV.basis; PQ0.basis; ...
326:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:GIS-Q0-50-high-set-DISABLED-unless-justified'; ...
327:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:distance-settings-no-source'; ...
328:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:remote-grid-monitoring-only-no-device'};
329: src = {P51.source; PN.source; PHV.source; PQ0.source; ...
330:     'MISSING:no-high-set-source'; 'MISSING:no-distance-source'; 'MISSING:no-device'};
331: val = {[P51.validation ';tms-study-default-0.1;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
332:     [PN.validation ';tms-study-default-0.1;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
333:     [PHV.validation ';tms-study-default-0.2;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
334:     [PQ0.validation ';tms-study-default-0.3;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
335:     'DISABLED-unless-justified;no high-set invented'; ...
336:     'NOTE-only;no settings invented'; ...

467: function hex = sha256file(path)
468: %SHA256FILE  SHA-256 hex digest via Java MessageDigest (no toolbox).
469: md = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');
470: jpath = java.io.File(path).toPath();

472: dig = md.digest();
473: bi = java.math.BigInteger(1, dig);
474: hex = char(bi.toString(16));
475: hex = [repmat('0', 1, 64 - numel(hex)) hex];

# Phase-5 Final Report — Physical Protection Architecture + Qualified Backup OC/EF Coordination Study

## Ashuganj South 450 MW CCPP (EEE 306 Power Project)

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Tag:** production-v2
**Base:** frozen `results/phase4_fault/production/` (read-only; never modified)
**v1 reference:** frozen `results/phase5_protection/` (read-only; never modified; see §20 v1 appendix)

**Validation:** 16/16 legs pass (frozen `phase5_validate` regression R0,V1–V15); v2 legs B01+ via `phase5b_validate` (see C12); test suite NP=355 NF=0 (`run_phase5_tests` at v2 stamp)

> Language convention (binding for this report, spec S1): every number below is either **SOURCE-BACKED**
> (imported from frozen Phase-4 production data, workspace-verified drawings/reports, or confirmed ratings),
> **DERIVED** (computed from SOURCE-BACKED inputs by shipped MATLAB code), **USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC**
> (user-supplied 7UM622 values listed in spec S3, numerically separated, status PENDING-DOC-INGEST),
> **ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION** explicitly labelled as such, **LEGACY** (fenced sensitivity only), or **MISSING**
> (NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA, never invented). Primary scope is "Physical protection architecture +
> qualified backup overcurrent/earth-fault coordination study." Nothing here claims all installed functions were
> simulated. Coordination shortfalls are "study-setting coordination shortfalls," never verdicts about installed
> equipment. TCCs are split into PHYSICAL/SOURCE-BACKED vs GENERIC STUDY classes. All relay data are **study
> settings** evaluated in a **qualified model**. The peak current `ip` is a borrowed-shape design-defined quantity
> (informational only, never a breaker-duty input).

---

## 1. Executive summary

Phase-5b applies a physical protection architecture plus a qualified backup-OC/EF coordination study to the
frozen Phase-4 production fault package for Ashuganj South, covering 2 cases (`LF360_GAT_OUT`,
`LF360_GAT_IN`) x 5 fault locations (F1–F5) x 4 fault types (LLL/LG/LL/LLG) = 40 backbone rows.

Headline v2 results (each reproduced from the shipped `results/phase5_protection_v2/` CSVs, read with
`readtable(fp, 'Delimiter', ',')`):

- Study pickups (v2, as found): GEN-51-SI **17170.8 A** primary (1.20xImax 14309 A), GEN-51N-SI-STUDY **5 A**
  primary (SENSITIVE retained case), GSUT-HV-51 **1380 A** primary via 1600/1, GIS-Q0-51 **1043.94798235109 A**
  primary via 1600/1 (`phase5_relay_settings.csv`, 8 rows). Separate PHYSICAL baseline GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL
  **17171 A** primary (1.1447 A secondary via 15000/1, DT-??, tdef 3.00 s ?? PENDING-COORDINATION,
  USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC, inverse prohibited — never dispatched to `phase5_time`).
- Coordination matrix v2 (96 rows, as found): **FAIL = 20, NO-TRIP = 28, NO-PAIR = 24,
  NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA = 24, PASS = 0 (production-v2, 96 rows)**. Identical counts appear in
  `phase5_coordination_margins.csv`. No margin was tuned; shortfalls are study-setting coordination shortfalls
  reported honestly (see Sections 9 and 17).
- Breaker duty v2 (81 rows, as found): **40 x Q0 NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA + 40 x 52G PASS +
  1 x Q0 NOTE**. That is 40 Q0 rows with no interrupting rating sourced, 40 52G rows PASS vs the sourced
  52G/GCB-10BAC10 100 kA sym breaking rating, plus one informational NOTE (F3 LLL 50.530885 kA +1.06% vs the
  estimated 50 kA station reference). Equipment withstand (GIS 50 kA) lives only in equipment columns, never as
  an interrupting rating.
- Effectiveness v2 (`phase5b_effectiveness.csv`, 48 rows = 40 backbone + 8 Siemens-baseline F1 duplicates, as
  found): **ASSERTABLE-DETECT = 24, NOT-DETERMINABLE = 24**. F1/F2 primaries assertable (87G/87T); F3/F4/F5
  primaries NOT-DETERMINABLE (87B/7SD settings missing; F5 out-of-zone). Primary timing 0.045 s derived
  fast-main clearing applies only to F1/87G + 52G identified; all other primary times NaN with reasons (see
  Section 16).
- Low-earth-fault physics preserved: F1 LG **7.272 A** primary -> **0.4848 mA** secondary through
  15000/1, covered by the 5 A sensitive EF study pickup with margin **1.454**; branch-through-current
  F1 LG GEN_Q **8.4141 kA** pinned by audit (never a bus total).
- Sensitivity (60 rows, all scope SENSITIVITY): 16000/1 recomputation fenced to generator-CT scope only.
  Validation **16/16** frozen-framework legs; suite **355 passed / 0 failed** at the v2 stamp (v1 suite 344/0 is
  frozen in the §20 v1 appendix).
